notes.title: Popular idle game Melvor Idle is getting a sequel with Melvor Idle 2 bringing some huge new features
notes.content:
Coming sometime soon to Early Access, Melvor Idle 2 has been announced by developer Games by Malcs. Building upon the success and popularity of the first game, but with some big new features to hook you in.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/popular-idle-game-melvor-idle-is-getting-a-sequel-with-melvor-idle-2-bringing-some-huge-new-features/
